title: Data-driven analysis of metastability in a stochastic bistable system
summary: We present a methodology to analyze metastable properties of a simple prototypical stochastic bistable system by identifying slow inter-well and fast saddle escape processes using the formalism of the Koopman operator. Instead of studying noise-induced transitions by following the trajectories of the system, we track them by studying the time evolution and the decay rate of the subdominant mode of the Koopman operator, thus in a geometry-agnostic framework.
